      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Create a sample dataset for EDA (Replace this with your own dataset, e.g., pd.read_csv('your_file.csv'))\n",
        "data = {\n",
        "    'Category': ['Electronics', 'Clothing', 'Electronics', 'Home & Kitchen', 'Clothing', 'Electronics', 'Books', 'Home & Kitchen', 'Books', 'Electronics'],\n",
        "    'Price': [1200, 50, 800, 300, 80, 1500, 20, 150, 15, 600],\n",
        "    'Quantity': [1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2, 10, 2],\n",
        "    'Rating': [4.5, 4.0, 4.8, 3.9, 4.2, 4.7, 4.1, 4.0, 4.5, 4.3]\n",
        "}\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame(data)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Basic EDA\n",
        "print(\"--- Dataset Info ---\")\n",
        "print(df.info())\n",
        "print(\"\\n--- Summary Statistics ---\")\n",
        "print(df.describe(include='all'))\n",
        "print(\"\\n--- Missing Values ---\")\n",
        "print(df.isnull().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Pie Chart visualization of categorical distribution\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Pie Chart 1: Distribution of items across Categories\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)\n",
        "category_counts = df['Category'].value_counts()\n",
        "plt.pie(category_counts, labels=category_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=140, colors=sns.color_palette('pastel'))\n",
        "plt.title('Distribution of Sales Categories')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Pie Chart 2: Total revenue distribution across Categories\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)\n",
        "df['Revenue'] = df['Price'] * df['Quantity']\n",
        "revenue_by_category = df.groupby('Category')['Revenue'].sum()\n",
        "plt.pie(revenue_by_category, labels=revenue_by_category.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=140, colors=sns.color_palette('Set2'))\n",
        "plt.title('Revenue Contribution by Category')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"

        "id": "ee050fd0",
        "outputId": "130cdf5a-448e-4264-b8b7-b8b5427e0cb2"

      "source": [
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report\n",
        "\n",
        "# Ensure the 'Revenue' column is defined from the previous cell\n",
        "if 'Revenue' not in df.columns:\n",
        "    df['Revenue'] = df['Price'] * df['Quantity']\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Define Features (X) and Target (y)\n",
        "features = ['Price', 'Quantity', 'Rating', 'Revenue']\n",
        "X = df[features]\n",
        "y = df['Category']\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Split into 80% training and 20% testing\n",
        "# We remove stratify=y here because the test set size (2) is less than the number of unique classes (4)\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Training features shape: {X_train.shape}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Testing features shape: {X_test.shape}\\n\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Train a Random Forest Classifier\n",
        "model = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42, n_estimators=10)\n",
        "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 4. Predict on the test set\n",
        "y_pred = model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 5. Accuracy and Classification Report\n",
        "accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "print(f\"Model Accuracy: {accuracy * 100:.2f}%\\n\")\n",
        "print(\"Classification Report:\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0))"
      ],
      "execution_count": 5,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Training features shape: (8, 4)\n",

      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Generate predictions for all 10 rows using our trained model\n",
        "all_features = df[features]\n",
        "predictions = model.predict(all_features)\n",
        "\n",
        "# 2. Create a comparison table\n",
        "comparison_df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    'Index': df.index,\n",
        "    'Actual Category (Labelled)': df['Category'],\n",
        "    'Predicted Category': predictions,\n",
        "    'Prediction Match': df['Category'] == predictions\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "# 3. Display the results\n",
        "print(\"--- Comparison of Actual vs Predicted on all 10 rows ---\")\n",
        "display(comparison_df)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate overall accuracy on the entire dataset\n",
        "overall_accuracy = (comparison_df['Prediction Match'].sum() / len(comparison_df)) * 100\n",
        "print(f\"\\nOverall Model Accuracy across all 10 rows: {overall_accuracy:.2f}%\")"
      ],

      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import pickle\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "\n",
        "# 1. Define the dataset structure internally to guarantee independence\n",
        "data = {\n",
        "    'Category': ['Electronics', 'Clothing', 'Electronics', 'Home & Kitchen', 'Clothing', 'Electronics', 'Books', 'Home & Kitchen', 'Books', 'Electronics'],\n",
        "    'Price': [1200, 50, 800, 300, 80, 1500, 20, 150, 15, 600],\n",
        "    'Quantity': [1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2, 10, 2],\n",

        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report\n",
        "import pickle\n",
        "\n",
        "# Dataset creation\n",
        "data = {\n",
        "    'Category': ['Electronics', 'Clothing', 'Electronics', 'Home & Kitchen', 'Clothing', 'Electronics', 'Books', 'Home & Kitchen', 'Books', 'Electronics'],\n",
        "    'Price': [1200, 50, 800, 300, 80, 1500, 20, 150, 15, 600],\n",
        "    'Quantity': [1, 2, 1, 1, 3, 1, 5, 2, 10, 2],\n",
        "    'Rating': [4.5, 4.0, 4.8, 3.9, 4.2, 4.7, 4.1, 4.0, 4.5, 4.3]\n",
        "}\n",

        "df['Revenue'] = df['Price'] * df['Quantity']\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train test split\n",
        "features = ['Price', 'Quantity', 'Rating', 'Revenue']\n",
        "X = df[features]\n",
        "y = df['Category']\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42)\n",

        "\"\"\"\n",

        "    file.write(code_content.strip())\n",
